description: This file contains unit tests for the 'CreateServiceContainer' function within the 'application' package, specifically testing the initialization of various core services and feature toggles related to DIDs and storage configurations.

methods.name: TestCreateServiceContainerWithoutDID
methods.description: Tests creation of service container with default configuration, expecting core services to be initialized and DID services to be nil when feature is disabled.

methods.name: TestCreateServiceContainerDIDWithoutStorageFallback
methods.description: Tests creation of service container with DID feature enabled but invalid storage mode, expecting DID services to remain nil due to initialization failure.

methods.name: TestCreateServiceContainerWithLocalDID
methods.description: Tests creation of service container with local storage mode, ensuring storage initialization, DID, and VC services are properly instantiated when configuration is valid.
